DynamicEventBridgeRules.Note: NO static trigger and NO resource-based policy at rest. Invoked by EventBridge rules named pest-sched-{camera_id}-{action} that pest-monitoring-api creates on demand when a user schedules a camera. Each rule uses cron(mm hh ? * DAYS *) UTC and passes Input {camera_id, action, schedule_id, trigger_time}. pest-monitoring-api adds the per-rule lambda:AddPermission (StatementId sched-invoke-<rule>, Principal events.amazonaws.com) itself.
DynamicEventBridgeRules.AlsoInvokedDirectly: pest-monitoring-api can invoke this function synchronously via SCHEDULE_EXECUTOR_ARN for immediate start/stop.
